text:
jessica: Quick sync — Redwood <> Helix POC scope and sandbox handoff. Need to lock success criteria, data access path, and any SQ blockers. Proposed timeline: 2-week eval (ingest + ~5k prompts).

michael: Suggest concrete pass/fail: 1) p95 latency < 400ms, 2) retrieval/QA accuracy > 85% on labelled eval set, 3) zero PII exfil in outputs (checked by redaction tests). Feasible?

tiffany-cust: Agree on latency and accuracy targets. On data: we can provide a synthetic subset + a few masked real snippets. Prefer S3-based ingestion over ad-hoc uploads.

ryan: S3 is easiest. Two options we support for POC: a) cross-account read-only role scoped to a prefix, b) presigned uploads into a dedicated, short-lived bucket. If they require VPC egress rules or private peering, that pushes to Private deployment and longer timeline.

jessica: Customer flagged SQ-2026 (their security questionnaire) — requirement: redaction before data leaves their tenant. Can SEs propose a minimal redaction approach we can include in the SOW?

michael: Dropping a small python redactor they can run client-side. Not exhaustive but good for sample data:
```python
import re

def redact(text):
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}-\d{4}\b", "[REDACTED_CARD]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", text)
    text = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", text)
    return text
```
Use this on the staging dataset before upload.

tiffany-cust: That helps. For eval plan — we'll deliver 2k rows with schema: id, prompt, expected_answer, metadata{source, category}. OK to include category tags?

ryan: Yes — category tags allow stratified evals. For scoring we recommend a fuzzy match metric (token-overlap >= 0.8) plus exact-match for defined fields. We'll provide a small scoring harness.

jessica: Pricing question — they asked about burst capacity during evaluation. For a short POC we can do a temporary reserved pool or promo burst rate. Sales, can we offer a capped spend and short-term reserved capacity for 2 weeks?

michael: Standard practice: propose a capped POC budget + alerts. I can draft: flat setup fee + daily reserved node charge (discounted) + per-token overage. That should cover burst windows.

sec-bot: Ticket created: SQ-2026-response (TICKET-5892). Assigned to security@redwood. ETA for first-pass questionnaire response: 48h.

tiffany-cust: Timeline check: we aim to deliver sample data by Mon EOD, Redwood to run ingest Tue, run eval Wed-Thu, and final POC report Fri. Is that realistic?

jessica: Looks good. Action items recap:
- @tiffany-cust: upload sanitized CSV to the presigned link (we'll send link today)
- @michael: share redaction script + scoring harness by EOD
- @ryan: provide S3 cross-account role ARNs and network notes (egress/IP allowlist, if needed)
- @jessica: draft POC SOW with pricing cap and ship to legal for review
Reconvene Wed 10am PT. :thumbsup:

michael: I'll also add a short smoke test they can run locally (sample prompts + expected output) so we can validate scoring pipeline before ingest.

tiffany-cust: Thanks — appreciate the clear plan. I'll start preparing the 2k sample and the SQ artefacts.

jessica: Thanks everyone. If security wants anything stricter we can toggle to presigned-only flow to avoid cross-account roles. See you Wed.
